chunks: From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from al-Nawfali, from al-Ya'qubi, from Isa ibn Abdillah al-Hashimi, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:

Ali (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no harm in marrying her during her postpartum period, but he should not have intercourse with her until she is purified from the postpartum blood.' And this report does not contradict what has been narrated:
ai.seo_question: Can a man marry a woman during her postpartum period (nifas) even if she hasn't completed her purification?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam Ali (AS) clarifies the jurisprudential distinction between the validity of the marriage contract (nikah), which takes effect immediately, and the permissibility of sexual intercourse, which is suspended until the completion of postpartum purification (istihada). This hadith, recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, underscores the Shia legal principle that ritual impurity from bleeding does not invalidate the marital bond itself, allowing couples to remain legally married while awaiting the end of the bleeding period before resuming conjugal relations.
